algorithm.label: Algorithm
algorithm.desc: MaxRects usually packs tighter; Skyline is faster for many similar sprites.

heuristic.label: Placement heuristic
heuristic.desc: How the free spot for each sprite is chosen.

forcePot.label: Power of two
forcePot.desc: Page sizes are powers of two (256, 512, 1024…).

sizeMode.label: Page size
sizeMode.desc: Shrink each page to its content, or always use the maximum size.

extrude.label: Extrude
extrude.desc: Repeat each sprite's edge pixels outward to avoid bleeding when filtering.

border.label: Border
border.desc: Transparent pixels kept free along the page edges.

trim.label: Trim transparent edges
trim.desc: Pack only the visible part; offsets are written to the metadata.

trimThreshold.label: Trim alpha threshold
trimThreshold.desc: Pixels with alpha at or below this value count as transparent.

allowRotation.label: Allow rotation
allowRotation.desc: Sprites may be rotated 90° when that packs tighter.

unsupported.unity: Unity sprites cannot be rotated in a texture, so rotation is turned off for this exporter.
unsupported.godot: Godot AtlasTexture regions cannot be rotated, so rotation is turned off for this exporter.

dedupe.label: Merge identical images
dedupe.desc: Sprites with identical pixels share one area of the atlas.

multiPage.label: Multiple pages
multiPage.desc: Spill onto extra pages instead of failing when sprites don't fit.

premultiplyAlpha.label: Premultiplied alpha
premultiplyAlpha.desc: Store colors multiplied by alpha (for premultiplied blending).

kind.label: Export for
kind.desc: One exporter per export; only its options are shown.

format.label: Frames layout
format.desc: Hash: frames keyed by name. Array: list with a filename field.

imagePathPrefix.label: Image path prefix
imagePathPrefix.desc: Prepended to the page file name in meta.image.

pixelsPerUnit.label: Pixels per unit
pixelsPerUnit.desc: How many pixels make one world unit.

maxTextureSize.label: Max texture size
maxTextureSize.desc: Automatic picks the smallest Unity size that holds the page.

preservePivotOnTrim.label: Keep pivot of trimmed sprites
preservePivotOnTrim.desc: Trimmed sprites render at the same place as the untrimmed originals.

resPath.label: Resource folder
resPath.desc: res:// folder that will contain the exported page images.

outputSubfolder.label: .tres subfolder
outputSubfolder.desc: Relative to the output folder; empty = next to the image.

filterClip.label: Filter clip
filterClip.desc: Prevents neighbouring sprites from bleeding in when filtering.

fileExtension.label: File extension
fileExtension.desc: Paper2D imports .paper2dsprites files; JSON is the same content.

layoutReset.maxSizeReduced: the maximum size is smaller than the existing pages
layoutReset.notPot: existing pages are not powers of two

errors.subfolder: Use a relative folder without ".." or drive letters

baseName.trailingDotOrSpace: Base name cannot start with a space or end with a dot or space
baseName.reserved: This name is reserved by Windows

mode.label: When the atlas already exists
mode.keepPositionsDesc: Existing sprites stay where they are; new ones fill free space.
mode.repackOptimalDesc: Everything is packed again for the smallest atlas (engine IDs are kept).

removeMissing.label: Remove sprites not in the current list
removeMissing.desc: Off: sprites already in the atlas are kept even if their images are not listed here.

existing.title: Existing atlas
existing.none: No atlas here yet; a new one will be created.

preview.empty: Add images to see the atlas.

tooltip.notInList: Not in the current list (kept from the existing atlas)
